design.sampling: One shared bank of 2000 independent standardized Gaussian paths; correlated conditions. Main grid fixed before execution. Scaling baseline reuses the main baseline case.

sampling_note: Independent paths within each condition; shared standardized innovations across all conditions. Conditions are correlated; do not sum trials across conditions.

Intervals quantify Monte Carlo mean uncertainty, not real-world forecast uncertainty.
